title: zflip5-modem-module daemon config
$comment: cpu and hotspot are written by the first-boot template and persisted by the daemon; they are optional so older configs still validate.

bind_host.description: api-front listen address. Loopback-only unless ingress.mode enables a private tunnel. The pattern rejects any all-interfaces / public bind.

tokens.description: Scoped, independently revocable bearer tokens (>=256-bit -> >=64 hex chars). Generated at first boot, 0600 under /data/adb.

mode.description: loopback = local only. tailscale = userspace tailscaled + tailscale serve for the iPhone path; a separate public relay (holding no sms token) handles Discord.

relay.description: Public Discord relay. MUST NOT be granted the sms scope.

warn_c.description: Owner-adjustable warn threshold (floor 30C, must stay below gate_c). Clamped by the daemon on load and on every retune.

gate_c.description: Above this (battery temp or hottest sysfs zone) radio/tether writes are refused. Hard-capped at 48C: the gate can be retuned but never disabled.

fail_closed.description: If thermal cannot be read, treat as unsafe. PRIMARY source is battery temp + /sys/class/thermal; Android status is advisory.

bench.description: Explicit opt-in for battery-less donor hardware on a bench supply: disables OS thermal mitigation (thermal zones + HAL + Samsung kernel cpufreq_limit) and lifts the app gate to 70C. A critical trip at 70C restores mitigation. Off by default.

cpu.description: Reversible CPU power/perf policy. Only ever reduces when hot; never offlines the little cluster (cpu0-2).

enable_on_boot.description: Bring the hotspot up at boot from the saved SoftAP config.

ssid_whitelist.description: Auto-toggle: hotspot turns OFF when any listed SSID is scanned nearby, back ON when none is seen. Empty disables the feature.

redact_default.description: Bodies redacted by default; full body is a separate off-by-default endpoint with its own credential + per-request confirm.

forward.description: No default forwarding of messages to any channel.

path.description: SMS never traverses the Discord relay.
